props.title: The Westin Westminster
props.lede: The Westin Westminster has over 100,000 sq ft of event space off US 36, between Denver and Boulder, with three ballrooms and a string of courtyards, gardens and terraces outside them.

headingText.html: It hosts big conferences, company parties and weddings, including Indian weddings, which the hotel plans for.

props.title: Event spaces at the Westin Westminster

rows.text: The Westminster Ballroom is about 11,900 sq ft with 22-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to 840 and receptions of up to 1,200. It divides into four sections.
The Legacy Ballroom is about 9,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 675 and receptions of up to 960. The Standley Ballroom is about 4,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 320 and receptions of up to 500.
The Waterfall Gardens are about 19,800 sq ft outdoors, for receptions of up to 400. The North and South courtyards hold receptions of up to 350 and 400.
The Lake House is about 3,300 sq ft, for banquets of up to 200 and receptions of up to 250.
The Sunset Rooftop Deck is about 2,700 sq ft, for banquets of up to 110 and receptions of up to 140.

props.title: Live music in the Westminster and Legacy ballrooms
props.lede: They’re the spaces for conference parties, awards dinners, big weddings and holiday parties.

props.title: Live music in the Waterfall Gardens, the Lake House and on the rooftop
props.lede: They’re lovely for ceremonies, cocktail hours, rehearsal dinners and welcome receptions.

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV in-house.
We plan load-in and setup with the hotel’s events team.
The gardens, courtyards and rooftop are outdoors, so we’ll plan the music with an indoor backup in mind.

props.title: Ask about your date at the Westin Westminster.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your event at the hotel, from strings in the Waterfall Gardens to a full band in the Westminster Ballroom.
